digest.component_or_area: module-size gate enforcement and codebase restructuring
propositions: Six uncovered src/rebar files currently sit at 786–800 LOC, violating the hard 800-LOC cap with zero headroom for any future edits or comments.
Any modification to a file at or above the cap, including adding a single comment, causes CI module-size gate failure with no allowlist or exemption available.

Files must be split along existing logical concerns and architectural call-graph seams, never mechanically to reach a number, and each resulting file must be 100–500 LOC with measurable headroom below 720 LOC.

Splits must preserve all existing test behavior unchanged and update any registries or line-budgets tied to moved symbols in the same commit; the locked limit in .github/module-size-limit.txt cannot be raised.
Census data is stale after 45 recent merges including substantial new code; next session must re-measure current origin/main before selecting extraction targets.
